_source: live tools/list against https://mcp.skilljar.com/mcp via an authenticated Claude Code session
_note: Parity baseline for ADR-006. Argument names are reproduced exactly; 'paginated' records whether the official tool accepts page.cursor/page.size at all.

list_courses.desc: List non-deleted, non-draft courses for the authenticated organization.

filter.title.desc: Case-insensitive partial match on course title.

list_lessons.desc: List non-draft lessons for the authenticated organization.

filter.course_id.desc: Obfuscated parent course ID. Exact match.

filter.type.desc: Lesson type. Unknown values rejected with 422.

filter.updated_since.desc: ISO-8601 with timezone offset; naive datetimes rejected with 422.

list_quizzes.desc: List live quizzes for the authenticated organization.

filter.updated_since.desc: ISO-8601 with timezone offset; naive rejected with 422.

list_questions.desc: List live questions for the authenticated organization.

filter.question_bank_id.desc: Obfuscated parent question bank ID. Exact match.

filter.quiz_id.desc: Obfuscated parent quiz ID. Exact match.

list_question_banks.desc: List live question banks for the authenticated organization.

filter.name.desc: Question bank name. Case-insensitive exact match.

filter.updated_since.desc: ISO-8601 with timezone offset; naive rejected with 422.

list_web_packages.desc: List live web packages for the authenticated organization.

filter.access.desc: Return only domains with this access mode.

list_students.desc: List students for the authenticated organization.

list_groups.desc: List student groups for the authenticated organization.

filter.category_id.desc: Obfuscated StudentGroupCategory id. Undecodable/cross-org ids return zero results, never an error.

filter.name.desc: Case-insensitive substring on group name. Sequential scan; expected org cardinality < 1k groups.

list_enrollments.desc: List the organization's enrollments (active and inactive), one row per enrollment.

filter.active.desc: Active = active and not expired. Omit to return both.

list_published_courses.desc: List the organization's published courses (live and unpublished by default).

list_certificates.desc: List the organization's certificates, one row per issued certificate.

list_signup_field_values.desc: List the organization's captured signup-field values, one row per value.

list_course_ratings.desc: List a course's student ratings, most recent first.

list_visibility_overrides.desc: Cursor-paginated list of visibility overrides for the given group. 404 if the group does not exist in the caller's org (document-level, distinct from per-item not_found inside a 207).

filter.is_visible.desc: true = allowlist rows only; false = blocklist rows only; omit for both.

list_quiz_question_bank_assignments.desc: List the question-bank assignments for a quiz. Returns a plain unpaginated {"data":[...]} envelope - a quiz's bank assignments are a small bounded set. Malformed/cross-org/soft-deleted quiz_id raises a document-level 404.
